executive_summary: Day-30 checkpoint on Priority Recommendations: the primary outcome is healthy at 2.6817% treatment vs control. Subscription conversion in Android/GB fell 10.9881% over the window, and the decline is real — the funnel moves at checkout and stays down through activation, and instrumentation is healthy. It cannot be attributed to Priority Recommendations: the movement appears in the control arm at -9.5416% against -12.3748% in treatment, and EXP-4502, a single-page checkout redesign, is running on 60% of exactly this segment for exactly this period. Two explanations remain live and this checkpoint cannot separate them. Escalating.

segment_findings.observation: subscription_conversion_rate in Android/GB fell 10.9881% over the window and 11.7792% half-over-half. Treatment moved -12.3748% and control -9.5416%. The movement is present in the control arm at a comparable magnitude. A feature shipped only to treatment cannot cause this. Look for a release, a payment processor, or a measurement change affecting both arms.
segment_findings.limitations: The overlapping experiment covers 60% of this cell, so the residual attributable to anything else cannot be isolated from this data alone.

facts.statement: subscription_conversion_rate in Android/GB fell 10.9881% over the checkpoint window.
The Android/GB movement is present in both arms: -12.3748% in treatment and -9.5416% in control.
EXP-4502, a single-page checkout redesign, is running on 60% of Android/GB free users across the whole checkpoint window, with subscription_conversion_rate as its own primary metric.
Every critical event is above the 95% completeness floor in Android/GB, so the movement is not a measurement artefact.
recommendation_engagement_rate is 2.6817% treatment vs control, inside the contract's expected range.

hypotheses.statement: EXP-4502's checkout redesign may account for the Android/GB conversion decline; it covers 60% of the cell and targets the same metric.
hypotheses.how_to_test: Split Android/GB by EXP-4502 assignment. If the decline is concentrated in its treatment cells, EXP-4502 is the explanation.

hypotheses.statement: A market-level factor affecting all Android/GB users could explain the movement, since it is present in both arms of this experiment.
hypotheses.how_to_test: Check whether iOS/GB conversion moved over the same period. A market factor should not be confined to one platform.

hypotheses.statement: Priority Recommendations could have contributed to the decline by diverting attention from the paywall.
hypotheses.how_to_test: A treatment-only effect would not appear in control. Control fell -9.5416%, which largely rules this out as the main driver.

recommended_actions.action: Do not attribute the Android/GB conversion decline to Priority Recommendations in any onward reporting until EXP-4502 assignment is separated out.
recommended_actions.rationale: The movement is symmetric across arms and an overlapping experiment covers 60% of the cell. Attribution is not available from this checkpoint.

recommended_actions.action: Split Android/GB conversion by EXP-4502 assignment with the monetization analytics owner.
recommended_actions.rationale: Cheapest test that would separate the two live explanations.

escalation_reasons: Two explanations for the Android/GB decline remain live at comparable confidence, and this checkpoint cannot separate them.
EXP-4502 covers 60% of the affected segment, so clean attribution is unavailable.
